releases.new: Read and write encrypted Parquet files.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 is no longer supported, and eager arithmetic mixing strings and numbers now raises an error; upgrade Python and cast columns explicitly.

releases.new: Run larger-than-memory queries out of core by default, with a new streaming sort and an 80% RAM threshold.
releases.breaking: SQL window/QUALIFY semantics, SQL numeric literals now Decimal, Parquet ENUM now reads as String, and cut/qcut deprecated; review affected queries.

releases.new: Group SQL queries with GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP, CUBE and GROUPING() in the SQL frontend.
releases.breaking: Parquet ENUM columns now read as String, cut/qcut are deprecated, and the POLARS_STREAMING_CHUNK_SIZE setting is removed; update affected code.

releases.new: Write partitioned Iceberg sinks directly from Polars with configurable writer options.
releases.breaking: SQL queries now run on the streaming engine by default; if results or behavior differ, explicitly choose the previous engine.

releases.new: Add bitwise operations and aggregations on expressions and columns.
releases.breaking: Python 3.8 support is dropped, so upgrade to Python 3.9 or newer before installing this release.

releases.new: Join dataframes on a single inequality condition using join_where.
releases.breaking: Comparing Series of unequal length and reading parquet files with extra columns without select() now raise errors; fix input lengths or add select().
